summary: CONTRACT_M7 1.3, 1.4 and 1.6 done (resumed run: the code was already in place, this run tested it and rebuilt the APK). 1.3: Builder.BuildAndroid (-output, default Build/Android/Meuble.apk, -development as on Windows) switches to Android, builds, checks the APK is at most 150 MB, then switches back. ProjectSetup.EnsureAndroidSettings sets IL2CPP, ARM64, min API 26, target API auto (highest installed), landscape left/right only, com.meuble.undeuxtrois, Vulkan then GLES3, ASTC, debug keystore, Minimal stripping. Screen.sleepTimeout = NeverSleep is set by QualityTier.Apply on mobile. The Android back button arrives as Keyboard.escapeKey in the Input System, so the existing Escape path (pause / back) handles it with no new code. SDK/NDK/JDK: nothing to configure, the build used the editor module's own AndroidPlayer/SDK, NDK and OpenJDK. APK: 49.0 MB (51,351,354 bytes), built 14:31, Build Finished Success. No build warnings that matter (URP terrain shaders stripped, shader min16float notes, one CS0628 in Inhabitant.cs). 1.4: QualitySettings holds Bas, Moyen (Mobile_RPAsset, hard shadows, no SSAO in Mobile_Renderer) and Haut (PC_RPAsset), none excluded per platform. Defaults: Android/iPhone Moyen, the others Haut (PC unchanged). Runtime/QualityTier.cs applies the tier at once: SetQualityLevel, render scale 0.75 on Bas and 1 on Moyen (shared asset), bloom off on Bas through a priority-100 global volume (the look's profile is untouched), Android target frame rate 30/30/60 (PC keeps its setting). The Options page has a Qualite row that cycles Bas, Moyen, Haut. SaveData.options.quality is optional (missing or unknown means the platform default), version still 1. 1.6: SaveStore falls back when File.Replace is unsupported: write .tmp, copy the target to .bak (overwrite), delete the target, move the .tmp in. Load order unchanged: main, .tmp, .bak.
files_changed: ProjectSettings/QualitySettings.asset (Bas, Moyen, Haut and per platform defaults)
